candidates.description: This vector represents adverbs of manner, frequency, and qualification that modify verbs, adjectives, or clauses.
This feature vector represents the concept of the verb "to use" across various inflections, derivations, and languages.
This feature vector activates on words related to cleansing, washing, and draining liquids.
This vector represents the concept of water, liquids, and related waste management or cleaning processes.
This vector represents modal verbs expressing ability, possibility, or necessity across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents physical substances, materials, and fluid control components.
This vector represents the concept of fluid motion, currents, and continuous movement.
This feature vector is primarily associated with bathrooms, plumbing fixtures, and related domestic sanitation facilities.
This vector activates for words and subwords related to enclosed living spaces, rooms, and specific domestic areas like bathrooms and kitchens.
This vector represents spatial and directional terms denoting relative position or orientation.
